# StreetModels: realistic street and exterior models for the night jewellery-store block

Street furniture, signs, building details, buildings across the street and parked vehicles for the night scene outside the 16 x 12 m store: pavement, kerb, wet street, street lamps, the police car at the kerb. Made for Unity 6000.6.2f1 with the Built-in pipeline and no packages (OBJ/MTL plus textures). Prepared 2026-10-14. **Not imported or checked in Unity yet (unverified).**

- 12 photoscanned/PBR models from **Poly Haven** (CC0), one of them (ApartmentBlock) assembled from the Modular Urban Apartments Facade kit.
- 3 cars and 4 buildings by **Daniel Zhabotinsky** (CC BY 4.0, attribution required, see LICENSE.txt). Fictional makes; badges, number plates and a livery slogan were removed.
- ApartmentBlock's lit/dark room backdrops (ApartmentBlock_Interior_Color.jpg) are night re-lights of three **CC0 Poly Haven interior HDRIs** (Lebombo, St. Fagans Interior, Empty Warehouse 01); the HDRIs themselves are not shipped.
- 11 **project-made** procedural models (traffic light, bollard, cycle stand, signs, parking machine, gully grate, 1100 L container, bus shelter, LED light bar) with shared project-made textures. All names are fictional.
- **Revised 2026-10-15** after review: AirconGrille colour/alpha map, PottedPlant rebuilt (4,951 tris), new interior backdrops, DT_MaskedDetails cut-out PNG with double-sided fire escapes, MetalTrashCan/StreetBench colour maps at full brightness, zero-area triangles removed from all OBJs (see sources.json `revision_2026_10_15`).
- Total size **23.9 MB** (23,913,071 bytes, everything in this folder incl. `Source~`). Largest file SedanClassic.obj (2.5 MB). Every file is under 3 MB.

LICENSE.txt has the credits (copy the CC BY lines into the demo credits). sources.json has mirror commits, download URLs and SHA-256 of every source and shipped file. `Source~/` (ignored by Unity) holds the build scripts and `Preview.jpg`, a software render of every model.

## Conventions

| Item | Convention |
|---|---|
| Units / axes | Metres, Y up. Import with **Scale Factor 1**, Convert Units off. Unity's OBJ importer handles the handedness flip; lettering reads correctly. |
| Pivot | Base centre on y = 0 unless the table says otherwise (wall-mounted items keep the authored wall-side origin). |
| Facing | Street furniture and signs face **+Z** (towards the road/viewer). Cars: **forward = +X**. Buildings: see the table. |
| `<Name>.obj/.mtl` | `map_Kd` points at the colour map. Unity's OBJ importer reads only Kd, `map_Kd` and `d`; assign the other maps in code (DemoAssetLibrary) or on the material. |
| `_Color.jpg/.png` | Base colour, sRGB. Poly Haven colour maps have 50 % of the authored AO baked in. |
| `_Normal.jpg` | Tangent-space normal, OpenGL +Y (matches Unity). Texture Type = **Normal map**. |
| `_MetallicSmoothness.png` | R = metallic, G = B = 0, A = smoothness. **sRGB off**. Standard: Metallic slot, Source = Metallic Alpha, Smoothness scale 1 (same as ForensicModels, PBRExterior, NightMaterials). |
| Materials without maps | Constant Kd/`d` in the MTL; the wanted metallic/smoothness/emission values are in sources.json (`models.<Name>.obj.materials`). |
| Glass, lenses (`d` < 1) | Standard **Fade** (or Transparent), smoothness 0.9-0.95. |
| Cut-out maps (`_Color.png` with alpha) | `AirconUnit_AirconGrille_Color.png` and `DT_MaskedDetails_Color.png`: Standard Rendering Mode **Cutout**, Alpha Cutoff 0.5. Texture import: Alpha Is Transparency on, **Mip Maps Preserve Coverage** on (cutoff 0.5) so thin wires do not vanish at distance. The MTL cannot say Cutout; set it on the material (DemoAssetLibrary). |
| Double-sided parts | PottedPlant leaf blades and BuildingBrickCorner's DT_MaskedDetails cards (fire escapes, railings, wire) have their back faces duplicated in the OBJ, so the Standard shader (back-face culling) shows them from both sides; no Cull Off shader needed. |
| Normals | Poly Haven props and cars carry vertex normals (Normals = Import). ApartmentBlock, the Downtown buildings and all procedural models have **no normals**: Normals = Calculate, smoothing angle 30-45. |
| Shared textures | `DT_*` (Downtown buildings) and `Proc_*` (procedural props) are shared between several OBJs. `Proc_*_Normal.jpg` and `Proc_*_MetallicSmoothness.png` belong to the `Proc_PaintedMetal`, `Proc_Galvanised` and `Proc_CastIron` colour maps: every material whose `map_Kd` is `Proc_X_Color.jpg` takes `Proc_X_Normal.jpg` and `Proc_X_MetallicSmoothness.png` (the painted-metal colour is neutral; the MTL Kd tints it anthracite/black/yellow/green). Tile 1 UV = 1 m. |

## Wiring ideas

- **Street lighting:** StreetLamp every ~20 m on the store side with a warm Point light (range 12-15 m, intensity ~1.5) at y = 3.27 m and an emissive LampBulb; SecurityLight over the rear door with a narrow Spot light. Bake or use a few real-time lights only (Quest Link budget).
- **Across the street:** ApartmentBlock directly opposite (interior emission gives lit and dark windows), BuildingNarrowOffice and BuildingBrickCorner beside it, BuildingBrickArcade / BuildingBrickResidential further away. Put RollerShutterWindow/RollerShutterDoor over the ground-floor openings of the Downtown buildings, AirconUnit on a few facades, StreetNamePlate on a corner.
- **Kerb line:** Bollard row in front of the forced storefront (realistic anti-ram-raid detail), FireHydrant, SignNoStopping, StormDrainGrate in the wet gutter, ManholeCover on the road, ParkingMeter and BikeRack across the street, BusShelter with its lightbox lit, TrafficLight at the corner with only the red lens emissive.
- **Vehicles:** PoliceCar at the kerb outside the store (forward +X), optionally with PoliceLightBar replacing the car's own bar for a modern look; Hatchback and SedanClassic parked across the street. The existing KayKit police car can stay as the primitive fallback.
- **Service lane:** WasteContainer1100L and MetalTrashCan by the rear office side, UtilityBox against a wall.
- **Fallbacks:** keep the primitive/KayKit fallbacks in DemoAssetLibrary; every model here is optional.
- **Materials in code:** when DemoAssetLibrary builds Standard materials, switch AirconGrille and DT_MaskedDetails to Cutout (alpha 0.5) and give ApartmentBlock's Interior material its colour map as emission (x0.6-1.0).

## Not found / not included

- No CC0/CC BY realistic **trees** small enough for VR (Poly Haven trees are 30k-17M tris with heavy alpha cards); PottedPlant is the only greenery. A procedural or billboard street tree is still open.
- No redistributable realistic **ambulance or forensic van**, **mailbox** or **newspaper box** without brands; the Zhabotinsky "Urban Stuff/Garbage" prop sets (CC BY) exist only as Unity-imported .asset meshes in large game repositories and were not fetched.
- The police car is 1980s-styled (the only CC BY police car with fictional livery found); PoliceLightBar gives it or the KayKit car a modern LED bar.
